sloka: सा हि चंपक वर्ण आभा ग्रीवा ग्रैवेयक उचिता ।कोमला विलपन्त्याः तु कान्ताया भक्षिता शुभा ॥३-६०-३२॥
transliteration: sā hi caṁpaka varṇa ābhā grīvā graiveyaka ucitā ।komalā vilapantyāḥ tu kāntāyā bhakṣitā śubhā ॥3-60-32॥

translations.english: That delicate, beautiful neck of my beloved having the complexion of a champak flower and adorned with necklaces was perhaps eaten up.
